{

# Candidate crystals
- Crystal-K1: inorganic scintillator, high light yield, fast decay.
- Crystal-K2: inorganic scintillator, medium light yield.
- Crystal-K3: inorganic scintillator, mature growth process, lower light yield.
All three are available in the required sizes from at least one vendor.

# Earlier simulation summary (2025, nominal 5 cm thickness)
Energy resolution at 662 keV (FWHM): Crystal-K1 2.9%, Crystal-K2 4.5%, Crystal-K3 8.5%.
Thickness dependence was weak in the 3-8 cm range.

# Radiopurity assay campaign, Q1 2026
Sample crystals of each candidate were counted for 30 days in the underground HPGe station.
Intrinsic background of the crystal, 100-3000 keV (counts/kg/day):
- Crystal-K1: 2.0 +- 0.2   (dominated by internal contamination of the crystal itself)
- Crystal-K2: 0.30 +- 0.05
- Crystal-K3: 0.10 +- 0.03
Facility background budget for the spectrometer crystal: 0.5 counts/kg/day.
Contact: radiopurity working group.

# Meeting notes 2026-02-11
Attendees discussed the shielding upgrade (lead + copper, complete) and the schedule for commissioning in Q3. Action: finalise the crystal choice this quarter.

# Shielding status
The 20 cm lead + 5 cm OFHC copper castle is installed. Radon purge with boil-off nitrogen is operational.

# DAQ readout plan
The PMT signal is digitised at 250 MS/s with 14-bit ADCs. Firmware supports pulse-shape discrimination. No change is needed for any crystal candidate.

# Schedule
Q2: crystal procurement. Q3: assembly and commissioning. Q4: first assays.

input.justification:
Crystal-K1 has the best simulated resolution at 662 keV (2.9% FWHM vs 4.5% for K2 and 8.5% for K3, 2025 simulation at 5 cm), but its intrinsic background of 2.0 ± 0.2 counts/kg/day (Q1 2026 assay, dominated by internal contamination) is four times the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, so it cannot meet the low-background requirement. K3 is cleaner (0.10) but has nearly twice K2's resolution loss (8.5%). K2 meets the background budget (0.30 ± 0.05, confirmed by query_assay) and gives the best resolution among the compliant candidates. The simulation shows only weak thickness dependence over 3–8 cm, so 5 cm (the nominal simulated thickness, within the 2–10 cm constraint) is recommended; no thickness optimisation was available beyond that. The 4.5% figure is from the 2025 simulation and has not been re-validated for K2 at this thickness.</justification>
